fusions.name: Broadside Spit
fusions.desc: Spits 3 jets at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage and knocking the target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Wake Slap
fusions.desc: A thrown slap of water that deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Tailwind Hop
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 10 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Deck Walk

riders.text: you move over it faster than over ground

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. Over it you move faster than over ground.
